title: Unique Ethiopian Couscous Pilaf
description: A floral and chewy Ethiopian dish featuring couscous, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this vegan-friendly pilaf is a must try. It is made with namul-blanch-season method for added flavor.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large saucepan.
Add the namul to the boiling water and blanch for 2 minutes.
Remove the namul from the water with a slotted spoon and set aside.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the same water and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the berbere spice and salt to the water and stir to combine.
Add the couscous to the water, cover the saucepan, and turn off the heat.
Let the couscous steam for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the blanched namul to the skillet and cook until wilted.
Combine the cooked couscous and namul mixture in a large bowl and serve.
